out.build/final_audio.wav: Beautiful vows, and the back rows heard nothing. This made-up sound quote lists two speakers and a playlist. No wireless mic, no backup power, and nobody named to run it. So before you book, confirm three things in writing. Microphones, how many which are wireless and spare batteries? Power, where it plugs in, and what backs it up if it cuts out? Operator, who stays to run it from the vows to the last speech. Download Plan, My Wedding to keep your checklist.
